features.statement: Uses HTML5 semantic landmarks (header, nav, main, aside, footer, sections) instead of generic table or div structure.
Heading hierarchy has a single h1 for the site name, with h2s for page sections.
Head includes charset, viewport and description meta tags, with a plain document title lacking decorative punctuation.
Contact details are wrapped in an address element with bold name and underlined email link.
Styling is consolidated in a single style block with almost no inline styles, scripts or external stylesheets.
Every image has descriptive alt text rather than empty or terse alt attributes.
All text is set in a single serif family (Georgia) rather than sans-serif.
Body copy is larger, dark, left-aligned serif text instead of small grey justified paragraphs.
Section headings are large, regular-weight serif in a single slate color.
Sidebar sub-labels are small uppercase, letter-spaced grey text.
Header shows the site name as visible light text on a dark band, with an italic tagline.
Palette combines flat teal page background, dark slate tones and a gold/khaki accent.
Header is a dark gradient band holding a small shadowed logo card beside text.
Navigation is left-aligned bold serif tabs, with a gold-filled active tab and gold bottom rule.
Sidebar is split into separate white rounded cards with gaps, with generous menu row spacing.
Primary buttons and form inputs are full-width, with white inputs and a gold button with small radius.
Read-more links are bold, underlined, accent-colored and end with an arrow.
Thumbnails sit in padded white bordered frame cards in uniform grids.
Gallery and product grids reuse one placeholder image without captions.
Footer is a full-width near-black band with centered serif text.
Main content is a single centered card with even background margins on both sides.
Interactive elements use CSS transitions, and shadows add subtle depth.
The DOM is lean, with few anchors, lists and line breaks.
